GitHub - thewildnath/PathTracer: Direct Volume Rendering Path Tracer
Path Tracer This project is based on Exposure Render by Thomas Kroes and it extends it by implementing a full Monte Carlo path tracer similar to pbrt (but much simpler). It is a direct volume renderer, meaning that it supports interactive updates to the transform function, which can change how the volume is rendered in real-time.
